{
  "literal": "استيقظ واطحن",
  "adaptation": "فوق وعافر",
  "back_translation": "Perk up and strive",
  "approach": "adapted",
  "notes": "The literal verb for 'grind' lacks the 'hustle' double meaning in Arabic, so we used 'فوق' (Egyptian slang for getting alert, inherently linked to drinking coffee) and 'عافر' (striving/hustling) to capture the exact coffee-fueled motivational vibe."
}
